info.name: TnT — Error Code Conformance (52 cases)
info.description:
Every error code in Sheet1_Error_Code_Tests_DocsVsSystem.xlsx, executed against the live platform.

Tokens are supplied at run time (never stored here):

  npx newman run postman/TnT-ErrorCodes-52.postman_collection.json \
    --env-var base_url=$API_BASE_URL \
    --env-var mfg_token=$MANUFACTURER_API_TOKEN \
    --env-var fac_token=$FACILITY_API_TOKEN \
    --delay-request 1500

Requests prefixed "↳ setup" establish state for the case that follows; their failures are not conformance findings.
